name: 171. An exhausted fallback chain returns the primary's error with the primary's headers (exhausted-fallback-headers)
description:
When the primary and every fallback fail, core returns the primary's error. Each fallback attempt replaced the provider response headers on the request context with its own, so the primary's OpenAI error went out with the Anthropic fallback's request-id, organization, workspace and rate-limit headers. Core now restores the primary attempt's headers before returning its error.

Both rows send a missing OpenAI model with a missing Anthropic model as the fallback, so each attempt is a free 404: (1) on /v1/chat/completions and (2) on the /openai drop-in. Run with FEATURE="exhausted-fallback-headers".
